title: I had so much fun at the press day of @JOY | New Original Musical! ca...
transcript: I've been making TikToks about theatre for five years and one of the coolest things still to this day that I get to do is go into a rehearsal space it has never stopped being cool to me and today I got to go into the rehearsal room for a sneak peek of a new musical coming to off-Broadway this summer it's called joy a True New Musical it stars Betsy Wolfe and often times when the show is about to start on Broadway or off Broadway they'll do what's called a press day where they'll invite people to come into the rehearsal room they will show some songs show some scenes and then you can maybe like talk to some of the people in the show I get nervous so I never do the talking part but I love love love getting to see like sneak peeks and moments from the show here are a few of my favorite moments from the rehearsal room i’m Lorin Latarro and I’m lucky enough to Be directing this Glorious piece this is a dream come true for me and I am honored to stand around in between such talented people that work so hard I believe in hard work I knew I had to be uptempo and fun and said too much so I'm gonna let you hear the song I'm such like a theater nerd that I just find these opportunities like wild to me it's so vulnerable and I like never take it for granted that I'm invited into these spaces like these are performers who have been working probably for like a week two weeks on this show and now they're putting it on in front of people they're not in costume they're just in their rehearsal clothes sometimes it's fully staged sometimes it's not and then I love the fact that now I'll get to see the show in like a month or two fully costumed fully staged with lights with sound like all of it but I will still remember what it was like to see it here in this rehearsal space also being like five feet from Betsy Wolfe I love her so much joy a True new Musical starts June 21st at the Laura Pels Theater I can't wait to see it I was really excited about what I saw today I'm just feeling very lucky and thankful so go see joy
